title: Controller reports objects descending from above 80,000 feet
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Controller reports objects descending from above 80,000 feet, about 2004 at Off San Diego (Nimitz, 2004), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

10 days sure okay um they begin tracking anomalous objects at 28,000 ft heading south at 100 knots very strange tracks

as_told.title: Princeton radar tracks over ten days before the Nimitz encounter

plain: In 2004, off the coast of San Diego, a US Navy group led by the aircraft carrier Nimitz is said to have tracked strange objects in the sky. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, reads the words of a pilot: the radar controller told them the objects had been seen for over two weeks, dropping down from above 80,000 feet. A guest named Merrick von Rennenkampf, crediting a man named Kevin Day, tells it a little differently: about ten days of tracking, with odd objects at 28,000 feet moving south at 100 knots. If true, it would mean something was moving through the sky in ways no known aircraft does, and the Navy watched it for days.
